title: Barriers and facilitators for deprescribing in middle-aged adults (40-65 yrs) with chronic diseases: the role of perception, confidence and social support
summary:
We are conducting interviews with people between the ages of 40 and 65 who regularly take multiple medications. We want to understand their experiences with these medications – for example, regarding their effects, side effects, and impact on quality of life. We are also interested in their thoughts on reducing or stopping medications, and what kind of support they would like in this process.
These interviews are part of a doctoral thesis aimed at better understanding how people in this age group manage their medications and improving this process in the future.
conditions: Deprescribing in patients with chronic diseases

interventions.name: Adults (40-65 years) with chronic diseases are questionned once in an interview

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
-At least two diagnosed chronic diseases
-The use of at least 3 chronic medications
Exclusion criteria:
-Acute mental or physical disease, that may limit study participation
-inappropriate knowledge of the German language or limited vocabulary,  that prevents interview participation or the expression of detailed answers
-Life expectancy shorter than 6 months
